en.shortDescription: MCP aggregator, orchestrator, middleware, and gateway
en.longDescription:
MetaMCP unifies Model Context Protocol servers behind one app with PostgreSQL persistence.

Database credentials use SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES and SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES. Auth secret uses SERVICE_PASSWORD_AUTH.

de.longDescription:

Datenbank-Zugangsdaten verwenden SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES und SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES. Der Auth-Secret verwendet SERVICE_PASSWORD_AUTH.
